summary: Iteration 13 — Tested self-hosted Identity Verification (submit/status/admin queue/review), verified_only filter + owner_verified flag, and Recently-searched persistence. All 13 backend pytest cases passed (100%). Frontend flows verified: verify dialog opens with all form fields, /api/identity/verify/submit works end-to-end, pending banner appears, verified badges render on 17/19 tool cards, browse-verified-toggle sets URL + chip, Recently-searched row appears with 3 chips capped and persists after refresh, Admin Identity tab + filter buttons all present. One UI label nit: dashboard verify button still labeled 'Verify with Stripe' even though Stripe code was replaced with self-hosted flow.

ui_bugs.issue: Button text still says 'Verify with Stripe' even though Stripe was replaced with the self-hosted IDV flow. Should be 'Verify identity' (or i18n equivalent). The data-testid is also `start-verification-btn` (no 'verify' word) — review request implies a 'Verify' button. Functionality works (clicking opens verify-dialog), only labeling is stale.

issues: Repeated console errors from https://ipapi.co/json/ (CORS blocked). Geo-IP lookup is failing silently for every page load — consider catching/removing or routing through backend. Not related to identity feature but adds noise to logs.

action_items: Rename dashboard verify button from 'Verify with Stripe' to 'Verify identity' (or matching i18n key) — the Stripe word is misleading now that the flow is fully self-hosted.
(Optional) Rename data-testid `start-verification-btn` → `dashboard-verify-btn` (or add a `verify-btn` alias) so future Playwright scripts following the review-request naming work.
(Optional) Fix ipapi.co CORS noise — wrap geo-IP lookup in try/catch and proxy via backend.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend p1_features.py is 591 lines and growing — consider splitting identity verification into a separate module (identity.py) for maintainability.

Self-hosted IDV submission does NOT verify that id_document_path/selfie_path actually exist on disk or were uploaded by the same user. A malicious client could submit arbitrary paths. Recommend validating that paths begin with the expected /uploads/ prefix and (optionally) checking ownership via a small uploads metadata table.

id_number is stored in plaintext on the submission doc — only the hash field (id_number_hash) is privacy-protected and excluded from responses. Either drop the full id_number entirely after capturing last4+hash, or encrypt it at rest.

On rejection the user can NOT resubmit because /identity/verify/submit only handles the 'pending' replace-case and the not-started flow — but a rejected user has verification_status='rejected' and no pending submission, so the next submit creates a fresh pending doc. Confirmed working in the rejection test, but the flow relies on the UI clearing local state via `setStatus('not_started')` in VerifyIdentityDialog. Worth a dedicated backend test for the rejected→resubmit happy path.
Admin queue endpoint defaults to status='pending' and limits to 200 with no pagination — fine for now but document the cap.
Frontend recentSearches.ts: localStorage write is unguarded for quota errors only — JSON.parse on read silently returns []. Consider logging when storage is unavailable (e.g., Safari private mode).
